name: v2.3.4
body:
## Highlights

### Smaller bundles

Rspack now produces smaller bundles with less runtime code on modern targets, skipping unnecessary helpers, and improved tree-shaking.

### Clearer plugin, loader, and build diagnostics

Diagnostics across built-in plugins and loaders now include plugin names, loader names, and source filenames so issues are easier to trace back to configuration and source files.

### Solid v2 support

Rspack now supports Solid v2 through [`solid-loader`](https://github.com/rstackjs/solid-loader).
`create-rspack` now includes `solid-js` and `solid-ts` starter templates. You can now create Solid projects with `create-rspack`:

```bash
npm create rspack@latest -- --template solid-ts
```

See [#16752](https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16752).

## What's Changed
